scope: MecCog Step1 H5 published and preprint primary-evidence extraction
hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 disruption of lipid metabolism, compared with APOE3, results in impaired late endosome/lysosome function.

warnings: cholesterol depletion treatment includes time/dose conditions; mitochondrial respiration is not lysosomal flux
APOE secretion is context and not a direct lysosomal hydrolysis assay

source_papers.model: human isogenic iPSC microglia KOLF and UCI5
warnings: BIO RXIV PREPRINT NOT PEER REVIEWED
wells/frames are nested, not independent donor lines
late endo/lysosome pH not early endosome
figure lipid mediation untested, contextual evidence only

source_papers.model: human APOE3/APOE4 isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes, two distinct parental donor genetic backgrounds
warnings: Earlier same-study preprint is not counted as a second independent study
BODIPY-cholesterol is an upstream lipid endpoint, not lysosomal flux
DQ-BSA is a cleavage proxy; uptake and organelle number can affect signal
MβCD acts on membrane cholesterol and potentially other pathways
Individual donor and treatment p values belong to distinct rows
Supplementary second-donor n not independently confirmed; set N/A
Several non-cyclodextrin agents had neutral or negative rescue outcomes; individual p values not available
